title: Qasima Das Ki Tere Mei Shagan Manawan
body:
Mehmaan Tu Aj Di Raat Da Heyn Kiwain Mehndiyan Lawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasima Terian Phupian Nu Ki Dayvan Laag Vadhaaiaan
Zainab Tay Kalsoom Aj Tera Sehra Lay Kay Aaeeaan
Ey Sehra Lawaan Mathray Tay Ya Teri Qabar Tay Pawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Hathi Shagnan Waali Mehndi Mathray Laandiyaan Sehray
Watna Mal Mal Bandiyaan Gaana Kerdiyaan Shagan Batayray
Kadi Tahtul Hanak Valayndiyaan Hin Putaran Koun Mawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Ik Waari Saaray Jaa Kay So Gaey Nehr Di Ban Tay
Thaan Thaan Khilray Rait Garam Tay Tukray Hasan Day Chan Day
Ferwa Day Puttar Diyaan Baniyaan Kai Maqtalgawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Kubra Di Maan Ro Ro Kay Say-daanian Nu Samjhaaway
Ferwa Nu Aakho Qasim Da Aj Na Laaj Rachaavay
Jis Deen-e-Fajare Ujjarr Jaana Onu Kinj Pernaawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhtar Zainab Aakhay Sab Nu Rasiyan Mei Vartaeeaan
Saarian Haaathi Paa Kay Khariyaan Bhenan Tay Bharjaeeaan
Ik Raat Di Perni Banri Nu Kinj Rasiyan Paawaan
